issues.issue: The Police department has no salaries: this 377,154 is all of its spending and is almost certainly a law enforcement (sheriff) contract. The rules map such contracts to 'law enforcement contract'.

issues.on_page: Electric Fund operating expense 'Franchise fees' 333,911 (p7) = GF Franchise 333,911 (p5)
issues.issue: This is an interfund payment from the Electric Fund to the General Fund. It counts as business-type spending and as governmental revenue (entity-wide double count). Not labelled a transfer, so it is recorded as printed, but a person should confirm whether to treat it as a transfer. It is not in decision_needed.

issues.on_page: Grants 780,356 (nonoperating, Water Fund); Statement of Activities p3 shows it as Capital Grants and Contributions; cash flow p8 lists it under capital and related financing
issues.issue: This is a capital grant. It could belong in business_type.other_financing (capital contributions) rather than receipts. Its source (state or federal) isn't stated.

issues.on_page: Loan collections 17,383 (Micro Loan 1,892, CDBG 4,020, Sales Tax 11,471)
issues.issue: Repayments of loans the city made (principal) are not really revenue, and no category fits. The same applies to detail[81] (p12) and detail[88] (p13).
Printed as noncurrent. The rules limit 'accrued liabilities' to compensated absences due soon.

issues.on_page: Cemetery 38,841 is reported in the statement's Public works function (p5: GF Public works 38,841)
issues.issue: The category fits the department, but the detail function split won't tie to the statement's function lines (Public works mapped to streets/highways). Already marked review on the first line only.

issues.on_page: Fund balances 3,366,360; governmental funds cash and deposits total 3,370,784 less payroll liabilities 4,424 (p4)
issues.issue: Ending (and beginning) cash are fund balances under the modified cash basis, not cash. The difference is 4,424 payroll liabilities. Disclosed in notes.
